newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota treasurer sees smaller surplus this year.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota treasurer sees smaller surplus this year.

text.p: The Minnesota treasurer said Tuesday the state, which captured an astonishing surplus of about $2.5 billion in fiscal 1997, might see the strong economy pump up its coffers by about half that amount in the new year.
Michael McGrath, state treasurer, told Reuters in an interview, "I don't control or deal with projections, but my gut feeling is we're probably going to end up with a surplus of about half that."
The official was in Boston for a National Association of State Auditors, Comptrollers and Treasurers conference.
